acf.s017_h2:
Between the rainforest
and the Caribbean Sea
acf.s023_p: Set within quiet rainforest, with views over the clear Caribbean Sea.
acf.s025_p: Complimentary access to the resort's three private beaches, including its sea caves and outdoor seating areas.
acf.s027_p: Dominica is often called one of the most beautiful places on earth, with its natural landscape still largely untouched.
acf.s028_h2:
Invest in the 6-star
Secret Bay resort
and apply for Dominica citizenship
acf.s029_p: A renowned 6-star resort in the Caribbean.
acf.s030_p: An investment that meets the citizenship threshold, with income potential from a resort already in operation.
acf.s031_p: One of the faster and lower-cost citizenship programs, with a short 3-year holding period.
acf.s041_p: A share in a government-approved project
acf.s048_p: Ranked the No. 1 resort hotel in the Caribbean and No. 6 in the world by Travel + Leisure.
acf.s050_p: Approved by the Government of Dominica, and highly regarded there.
acf.s052_p: Nine consecutive years in operation, with a strong occupancy record and sound financial performance to date.
acf.s054_p: Projected average rental yield of 3–6% a year, with distributions paid to investors each quarter. Projected returns are not guaranteed.
acf.s062_p: The design brings local handcrafted interiors together with 6-star comforts.
acf.s064_p: GEMS Holding, based in Dominica, is the developer of Secret Bay.
acf.s068_p: GEMS owns, manages, and develops properties and projects in the international tourism and hospitality market, including the Fort Young Hotel and the Tibay villas.
acf.s071_p: GEMS develops and manages its projects, and looks after its guests, with an eye to the environment, so that the experience stays authentic, healthy, and close to nature.
acf.s074_p: IMM Group is an official partner of Secret Bay Residences Limited, part of GEMS Holding.
acf.s080_p: Holding a real estate share in Dominica can be more than an income-producing investment and a store of value held in US dollars. A share in Secret Bay — a resort already open and operating — also opens a route to citizenship for three generations of your family.
acf.s083_p: Secret Bay is a real estate project approved by the Government of Dominica.
acf.s085_p: The application is prepared in line with government requirements and goes through due diligence.
acf.s087_p: You complete the investment after approval in principle.
acf.s089_p: You receive Dominica citizenship if the government approves your application.
acf.s090_p: IMM Group helps prepare the application and represents your interests throughout the process.
acf.s096_li: You only need to hold the investment for 3 years.
acf.s097_li: You can sell the share after the holding period, on the terms the program sets.
acf.s101_li: A straightforward process, simple requirements, and a comparatively low investment amount.
acf.s102_li: Dominica runs one of the longest-established Citizenship by Investment (CBI) programs.
acf.s107_li: Visa-free access changes over time. The United Kingdom, for example, now requires Dominica citizens to obtain a visa, so the current list should be confirmed before you travel.
